name: threejs-animatic
description: Build a three.js animatic ("animatronic", 3D previz, blockout) of a multi-shot video: every storyboard shot becomes a schematic 3D scene drawn in code, with jointed mannequins and poses, master sets in real metres and props, a real camera per shot (START/END keys, lens in mm, move and ease), timed to the music or voiceover, reviewed in the browser with a top-down set map of every camera frustum, approved, exported as a camera plan, rendered to MP4 frame by frame (headless Chrome or HyperFrames), then used as the @video1 reference for Seedance 2.5 video-to-video on varg so the generated shots keep the approved camera and blocking. Use when someone asks for a three.js animatic or animatronic, a 3D previz or blockout, camera blocking, a camera plan, shot sizes and lenses, a grey-box of a storyboard, previz to Seedance, a reference video for video-to-video, or a look blockout (reference pictures as textures on the blockout, stills for look approval). Includes a working starter project (no npm).
